topic: A basketball court wiper surprises the crowd and arena by pulling off an incredible dunk with a ball that rolled to him.

hook.first_words: This guy was just wiping the court when a basketball suddenly rolled to him
hook.first_frame: A person cleaning the basketball court with a wiper, holding it in his hands on the court.
hook.on_screen_text_0_3s: THIS GUY WAS JUST WIPING THE COURT

shots.shows: Court wiper standing on the court, picking up a basketball that rolled to him
Court wiper throwing down a powerful dunk on the basketball hoop
Replay angle of the court wiper doing another dunk

ending.last_words: wasn't supposed to touch the ball.
ending.last_frame: The basketball dropping through the net after the dunk, crowd and court visible.

script: This guy was just wiping the court when a basketball suddenly rolled to him. And once the crowd saw it, they started cheering because they wanted him to shoot it. But instead, he surprised everyone by showing off a hidden talent, throwing down dunks like it was nothing. He pulled off dunks that could win in the dunk contest, even though he wasn't supposed to touch the ball.
what_makes_it_work: Unexpected skill from an ordinary staff member
High-energy commentary paired with impressive athletic action
Replay angle highlighting the impressive dunk
